newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's forex reserves fall in August.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's forex reserves fall in August.

text.p: South Korea's foreign exchange reserves fell to $33.56 billion at the end of August from $35.06 billion a month ago, the Bank of Korea said on Tuesday.
In a statement the bank blamed the fall mainly on the ballooning current account deficit.
On Tuesday the bank said the current account deficit widened to $3.49 billion in August from a $828.3 million shortfall a year earlier.
South Korea's foreign exchange reserves stood at $32.71 billion at the end of 1995, up from $25.67 billion at end-1994.
